reserves.name: Tokenized Treasury and money-market fund basket
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Taikang Asset Management, China Asset Management, and BNY Mellon Fund Management

reserveReview.rationale: FinChain names three tokenized money-market and Treasury-liquidity fund products backing FUSD and states a minimum 100% collateralization ratio, but it does not publish current product weights in the reviewed documentation. The reserve is therefore represented as one 100% aggregate fund basket.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current weights across the Taikang, ChinaAMC, and BNY Mellon products, plus their underlying holdings and maturity profile, are not published.
